226.text: "Clearly, the concerns driving voters are as varied and complex as the regions they come from."

227.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
227.text: "As you can see, the issues influencing the election are as dynamic and diverse as Rizia's people."

228.speaker: Player_Romus
228.text: "We’ll see how long their concerns last after the ballots are tallied."

230.speaker: Player_Romus
230.text: "Perhaps. But such unpredictability can also breed opportunity. Opportunity for those willing to seize it."

231.speaker: Player_Romus
231.text: "Public opinion is volatile, but leadership requires steady hands."

232.speaker: Player_Romus
232.text: "Despite the challenges, this election will serve as a reminder of the power of the people."

236.speaker: Narrator
236.text: He paused with a look of consternation on his face.

237.speaker: Manus Sazon
237.text: "I still don't understand, Your Majesty. We had a chance to stop the casualties and bring Vina home."

238.speaker: Player_Romus
238.text: "We'll bring her home on our terms. Not the Duke's."

239.speaker: Player_Romus
239.text: "If you think the Palesians would have kept those promises, you're even more gullible than I thought."

240.speaker: Player_Romus
240.text: "The life of a princess is no more valuable than the lives that will be lost if we let Pales continue their campaign of aggression against us."

241.speaker: Player_Romus
241.text: "I can't second-guess every decision I make. If I did, I wouldn't be King."

244.speaker: Daria de Rava
244.text: "And to be frank, the fact that you rejected our proposed ceasefire treaty brought my leadership abilities into question among our voter base."

245.speaker: Player_Romus
245.text: "You were making a mistake. The Duke would never have kept his promises."

247.speaker: Player_Romus
247.text: "Why didn't you override me if you thought I was making the wrong call? You had the power to do so."

251.speaker: Player_Romus
251.text: "This is exactly why I gave myself veto power. I'll take the fall for the continuation of the war, not you."

252.speaker: Player_Romus
252.text: "They'll come around once we achieve our victory."

256.speaker: Player_Romus
256.text: "You had the power to override me. Why didn't you?"

257.speaker: Manus Sazon
257.text: "A major disagreement between the monarch and the Prime Minister so soon after our reforms? It would have been an even bigger mess than the war."

261.speaker: Daria de Rava
261.text: "You are still head of state, Your Majesty. I would never let the treaty go ahead without your approval."

270.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
270.text: "As has the fact that we had to sign the peace treaty without the King's blessing."

274.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
274.text: "But the fact that we went ahead with the peace treaty without your approval did rankle traditionalists."

283.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
283.text: "Your actions went a long way towards ensuring the industry's wealth benefits not just the privileged few, but the everyday Rizian."

284.speaker: Player_Romus
284.text: "You're welcome. Should you be elected, I expect the redistribution of Rizia's wealth to continue."

286.speaker: Player_Romus
286.text: "That was a terrible idea. Rusty knew how to make the most of Rizia's resources."
